messages:
alina: Quick design review: the current timeline has a red 'Emergency revert' action pinned on each snapshot. Feels scary and screen-reader unfriendly. Can we rethink wording + discovery for power users?

jon: Agreed. Suggestion: default primary = "Revert (preview)" which opens a non-destructive preview. Put "Emergency revert (force)" in a kebab guarded behind a confirmation dialog. Keeps SRE flow fast but safer for wider audience.

miriam: A11y: screen readers need semantics, not just visual color. Use aria-labels that include scope and consequence, e.g. aria-label="Revert service to previous stable version, opens preview". Confirmation dialog must trap focus and include the exact sha/commit being reverted.

sam: For keyboard users: allow per-component local shortcuts (shown in a help popover) like "r" = preview revert, "R" = force revert (if enabled in settings). Avoid global shortcuts that clash with browser/page.

noah: Visual: overlapping canary bars are illegible in high-contrast mode. Propose using pattern fills + border outlines per variant. Example CSS fallback below for patterned fills:

```css
.canary-a { background-color: var(--canary-a); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 0 5px, transparent 5px 10px); }
.canary-b { background-color: var(--canary-b); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 0 5px, transparent 5px 10px); }
```

miriam: Also ensure keyboard focus outline is visible over patterns (use 3:1 contrast at least), and use aria-describedby to point to a hidden region that reads model metrics when a version is focused. Use aria-live="polite" for the scrubber summary so it doesn't interrupt typing.

alina: Microcopy: current toast says "Reverting...". Change to "Revert started — click to open progress or undo (available for 30s)". That indicates time window for undo and action affordance.

jon: UX flow note: when previewing a revert show a side-by-side diff of traffic allocation + effective latency/cost delta. Include a small CTA "Apply revert" and a subtle link "Force apply without canary" in the overflow menu.

sam: Can we add an inline snackbar action "View changes" that links to the version details panel? Makes recovery visibility easier.

miriam: Accessibility checklist from this thread: 1) aria-labels for revert controls with intent+scope, 2) scrubber summaries via aria-live="polite", 3) focus trap/restore for confirm dialogs, 4) pattern fills + visible focus outlines for canaries, 5) undo affordance announced in toast.

alina: Thanks all — I'll iterate the figma file and add an opt-in "power shortcuts" toggle in the prototype. @jon can you own the kebab/menu behavior? @miriam will you run a quick screen-reader pass once prototype is up?

devops-bot: ui-check queued: keyboard-e2e + a11y-smoke -> job #5899. Please link PR when ready. :white_check_mark:
